recipe_instructions.text: Stir in the Brazil Nut and set aside.
Fold in the Mace, Pinto Beans until the edges brown.
Stir in the Pinto Beans until glossy.
Stir in the Arrowroot until golden.
Stir in the Arrowroot, Mint, water as needed for about 5 minutes.
Chop the Brazil Nut and set aside.
Whisk the Mint, fresh herbs for serving, Tabasco until glossy.
Fold in the Brazil Nut, Tabasco, Haloumi until tender.
